name: iphone-mirror-mcp
description: Drive a real iPhone through the macOS iPhone Mirroring app, and run Xcode builds and tests on simulators and devices.
long_description:
Controls a physical iPhone through the built-in macOS iPhone Mirroring app — taps, swipes, typing, OCR screen reading, and template matching — with no jailbreak, nothing installed on the phone, and no XCUITest target. Also automates Xcode: build, test, install, and launch on simulators and paired devices, then operate the app on the mirrored screen and assert what the user actually sees.

Requires macOS 15 or newer paired to an iPhone on iOS 18 or newer, and Accessibility plus Screen Recording permission granted to the app that launches the server. Run the bundled binary with the `doctor` argument to verify the setup.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Which tools the server lists. read: observe only (status, screenshot, OCR, listings), nothing is sent to the phone. input: read plus taps, swipes, typing, keys, and navigation. full: every tool, including launching or restarting the mirroring app, recordings, and Xcode builds. Changing it restarts the server.
